text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Senate of Skopje university to discuss today government proposals for Albanian-language classes at Skopje Teachers' academy under pressure of Macedonian student demonstrations. Professors ask parliament to pass new higher education law that has been postponed for over three years.

- Macedonian students burned several copies of the paper Dnevnik in front of parliament. Demonstrations against Albanian-language classes at Teachers' Academy are only part of political manipulation campaign, says paper.
- Macedonian customs discovers 10 kilos of heroin in a car with Sofia licence plates. One Turkish and one Bulgarian citizen arrested.
- Several hundred workers of construction firm Pelagonia protested in front of management building demanding last year's outstanding wages. They announced protest march in Skopje.
- Burning of the daily Dnevnik by Macedonian students in front of parliament is nothing else but demonstration of fascism, says commentary.
